notes.title: Demo Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Tutorial blocks Hire Worker Menu (Fixed)
[*]Moving workstation causes workers can't follow new location (Fixed)
[*]When time stops any Menu can't close or open (Fixed)
[*]When Fire researcher , new researcher can't use same Research Desk (Fixed)
[/list]

Thank you for your continued feedback and support! It means a lot to us and helps make the game even better. Keep sharing your thoughts. We’re always listening!
